desc: Parse N, M, and S, and set MOD = 998244353.
Implement difference-bitmask LCS-row automaton: decode mask to dp row, apply standard LCS recurrence for each letter, encode next row to mask.
Precompute transitions for all reachable masks and all 26 letters.
Run DP over M appended characters from the zero mask, maintaining counts per mask modulo MOD.
Aggregate final counts by LCS length = popcount(mask), and print ans_0..ans_N separated by spaces.
Test on provided samples and edge cases such as N=1, M=1, and repeated characters in S.
